name: 10962 · Orangeburg, NY
findings: ZIP 10962 (Orangeburg) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10962 (Orangeburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10962 (Orangeburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
